info.name: Multi-Modal Master Agent Tests
info.description: Test collection for multi-modal chat API (images, audio, documents)

request.description: Simple test with a 1x1 red pixel PNG image. This is the fastest way to verify the multi-modal endpoint is working.
Test with a blue pixel image.
Test with investment context - green indicator.
Test with text-only content (no images). The multi-modal endpoint should handle this gracefully.
Test with multiple content items: text, image, text.
Test with three different colored indicators.
Test with image URL (placeholder.com). Note: requires internet access and model support for URL fetching.
Negative test: empty contents array should return error.
Negative test: image without data or uri should return validation error.
Template for your own images. Replace PASTE_YOUR_BASE64_IMAGE_HERE with your base64 encoded image. Use https://www.base64-image.de/ to convert your image.
